frostfire_periodic_can_crit.why: Client spell data flags Frostfire Bolt's periodic part as able to crit.

frostfire_ticks_trigger_impact.why: Unknown whether each Frostfire Bolt tick, or only the direct hit, can roll Impact's stun.

burning_soul_protects_frostfire.why: Burning Soul names Fire spells; Frostfire Bolt counts as both schools, so it probably applies.

frostfire_interrupt_lockout.why: Which school(s) an interrupt locks when it lands on a Frostfire Bolt cast.

fingers_of_frost_applies_to_frostfire.why: Unknown whether Fingers of Frost charges count Frostfire Bolt as a Frost spell.

aoe_target_cap.why: Client data has no MaxTargets on mage AoE; players report damage falling off past 4 targets.

sub20_spell_penalty.why: Classic cuts the spell power coefficient of spells learned below level 20 by 3.75% per level under 20; Forever client coefficients don't carry it (it's server-side).

thorns_spell_power_coefficient.why: The client gives Thorns (damage shield, aura 15) no spell power coefficient, but damage-shield scaling can be server-side; Forever's spell power gear may make Thorns scale (owner question, #265).

swiftmend_consumes_hot.why: Forever's Swiftmend heals for the HoT's full duration and, unlike Classic's text, doesn't say it consumes the HoT; if it does, Swiftmend only front-loads healing the HoT would have given (#279).

roots_break_health_pct.why: Forever's Entangling Roots keeps 'Damage caused may interrupt the effect', and Improved Entangling Roots lets victims take 25/50/75% more damage before it breaks, so there is a damage threshold; no public source gives it. 10% of the rooted target's maximum health is AzerothCore's threshold; 0 = roots never break (#286).

chain_jump_falloff_pct.why: Chain Lightning loses damage on each jump in Classic (30%); Forever's client data has neither the falloff nor the target count (#260).

fire_power_effects.why: Fire Power (1.60.1.70425) adds its % once per Fire effect on the target, up to a cap. A Fire mage's boss keeps Ignite and Fireball's DoT up; Pyroblast's DoT and Flamestrike only some of the time.

caveats: Questing and raid scenarios use a filler-plus-weaves rotation (Fire Blast, Scorch, Pyroblast, Ice Lance); Combustion, utility and PvP talents are not modeled yet (#57).
Stats, mob HP and mana budgets are rough Classic-era defaults (low confidence).

Respecs: Dual Specialization reportedly unlocks at 40, so a PvP and a PvE build can be carried together from then on. Before 40 a respec costs gold at a class trainer; the launch price is unpublished (the beta's cheapest respec is 1 silver since Oct 8; guides assume Classic's 1g, 5g, then +5g per respec up to 50g). See docs/research/forever-facts.md.

Dungeon scores assume a 5-player group (#220): a tank, a healer, two more DPS and you, weighted by how often each class and spec shows up in Forever Logs. Group buffs come from the game client at your level; each provider uses the option that helps your build type (Might and Windfury for physical damage, Kings and the Elements for casters); a warrior tank keeps 5 Sunders up. Shadow Weaving, Improved Scorch and Winter's Chill only help their own caster in Forever, so they aren't group buffs. Raids and questing are unbuffed.
